seo_title: Meeting Points & Directions | Simply Enak Food Tours
seo_description: Find your Simply Enak meeting point. Step-by-step directions to the start of each food tour in Kuala Lumpur and Penang — by train, taxi, or Grab.
hero_description: Step-by-step directions to every Simply Enak meeting point. Arrive confident — your guide will be waiting.
intro_text: We operate tours in Kuala Lumpur and Penang (George Town). Select your tour below for meeting point details, landmarks to look for, and transport options. Your guide will be wearing a blue Simply Enak badge.
tip_1_body: Tours start on time to respect everyone's schedule. A few minutes early means no stress.
tip_2_body: Your guide will be wearing a Simply Enak blue badge at the meeting point.
tip_3_body: WhatsApp us and we'll wait or guide you in.
